{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
print("Number of rows before removing QA orders:", len(df))

# Filter out QA rows
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']
print("Number of rows after removing QA orders:", len(df_clean))

# Confirm they are gone
print("Remaining QA rows (should be 0):", (df_clean['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Now convert revenue to float
df_clean['revenue_float'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Display the cleaned data
print("\nFirst 5 rows of cleaned data:")
print(df_clean[['revenue', 'revenue_float', 'channel', 'converted']].head())"}
